verdict.rationale: BILL publishes an official MCP server that Cursor, Windsurf, and Claude Desktop can connect to, but it serves only the BILL API documentation. Nothing shows an MCP server that lets an agent read or act on Spend & Expense data such as cards, budgets, transactions, or reimbursements. Missing for 10: an official MCP server exposing S&E product data and actions, setup and authentication documentation for such a server, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
